angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 53,708,040 km at 55005.40 pc = 0.01 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 1328: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 55005.4 +/- 4054.3 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 55005.4 +/- 4054.3 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.0036 +/- 0.0148 mas (same row, RUWE 1.11), 0.2 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 77.2 +/- 5.8 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 1328: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 77.2 +/- 5.8 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 53,708,040 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5750 +/- 125 K from Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=SMC0152, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5750 +/- 125 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=SMC0152, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5750 +/- 125 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 2.38 from 2021MNRAS.506..150B (GALAH DR3, a survey pipeline: no analysis of this star's own spectra is published); the 2 published values span log g 1.9191 to 2.3848, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.4% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.506..150B)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
